categories_thin: Retail (non-food): still thin — about a dozen independent shops (pet supply, two florists, thrift, jewelry/gold, appliance/TV, electronics, mattress maker, motorcycle, bicycle). Middlesex Borough's retail strip is small and dominated by chains the brief excludes.
Tutoring and test prep: one provider found (Eye Level Learning Center on Lincoln Blvd). The other result was a Kumon franchise, excluded as a chain/franchise.
Art schools / pottery: none in the borough; nearby options are in Plainfield, Scotch Plains and Summit.
Hotels and independent inns: none found in the borough.

Tree care: only one firm (Sami's) with a Middlesex Borough connection; the arborists that advertise 08846 service (Caffrey, Randy's, Wayne's, Raritan Valley) publish out-of-borough offices, so they were not listed. Pool service improved to two in-borough firms.
Siding/windows: three names found but only one (Thomas O'Brien) has a borough address; Rite-Way and M.W. Frederickson publish no street address, so they are listed with address Unknown.
Commercial printing: two established printers found and added; the rest of the category is small signs/screen-printing shops already listed.
caveats: Roughly half of the entries rest on bulk directories (NJ Business Directory, Loc8NearMe, BestProsInTown, Yahoo Local, Yellow Pages category pages) and have not been confirmed by a current website or recent map review; triage should verify.
Google Maps served a limited view from this browser profile (only 3 organic results per query), so map coverage is partial rather than complete.

Yellow Pages, Cylex, WhereOrg, Manta, Superpages, BBB, chamberofcommerce.com and AllPages mostly returned HTTP 403 to automated fetching; several of those addresses and phone numbers therefore come from search-result summaries of the page rather than a rendered read, and are marked as such in notes where it matters.
Phone numbers are recorded only where a directory or the business's own site published them; mobile-style numbers that looked personal were left out.

Excluded as chains/franchises per the brief: Honest-1 Auto Care, The UPS Store, Jaeger Lumber, Camp Bow Wow Middlesex, Dollar Tree/Dollar General/CVS, Kumon Math and Reading Center, Window World, SavATree, PuroClean of Middlesex (removed this round), D & B Auto Supply/NAPA (removed this round). BOC Gases was left out as a multinational plant.

Removed this round after verifier review: PuroClean of Middlesex (franchise), D & B Auto Supply (NAPA banner), Middlesex Presbyterian Preschool (church-affiliated, stale source), American Legion Catering Hall (nonprofit post hall), HomeCraft Paving & Masonry (no verifiable borough address), A & G Fine Foods and Flavor & Food Ingredients (food businesses).

Two scope questions need an orchestrator ruling and are flagged in notes rather than resolved here: (1) whether B2B food ingredient manufacturers/wholesalers count as excluded 'food' — the two such entries were removed pending the ruling; (2) whether licensed child-care centres and driving schools count as excluded 'schools' — the six such entries (four child-care, two driving schools) are kept and flagged because group D explicitly names childcare and driving schools.

Industrial/manufacturing entries on Lackland Dr, Baekeland Ave, Cedar Ave, Blackford Ave and Hallock Ave were mostly single-source NJBD rows; this round added second sources for Bomar, Trio Packaging, Spray-Tek, Premier Specialties, Koba, Jema American, Whitemarsh, Soneko and Fram Trak, but the rest remain single-source and may be inactive or shared addresses.
data_gaps: No official borough business registry / mercantile licence list is published on middlesexboro-nj.gov, so the borough's own roster of licensed businesses could not be used as ground truth. The verifier's coverage table (which named a list of specific missing businesses) was not included in this folder, so the gaps were re-worked from category searches instead: machine shops, commercial printing, landscaping and secondary roofers, each of which produced new entries.

The recommended spot-check against the New Jersey business-entity registry could not be completed: the state search portal was not reachable through the tools available, so manufacturing rows were instead corroborated (where possible) with a second independent directory, a supplier profile or a municipal record.

Genesis Landscape Contractors was not added: its listed website returned HTTP 404, and the only address found (165 Union Ave) is the same address another listed business uses, so it stayed unconfirmed.

Street addresses are missing for nine businesses that directories describe as Middlesex-based (Sami's Tree, Daivis Tree, Navarro Family Roofing, High Point Roofing, NDC Services, GEMCO, College Grads Moving, Rite-Way, M.W. Frederickson).
Several addresses conflict between directories (Rhodes & Sons; Precise Tool & Mold; Little Miracles; JR Driving School; Trio Packaging's Rd vs Ave), flagged in notes.
Home-based landscaping and trade firms publishing residential-looking street addresses were left out to avoid recording home addresses; they may represent real borough businesses.
Manufacturer headcounts are unknown; any site with over 500 staff should be dropped by the analysts (NutraBio Labs and Spray-Tek are the most likely large employers).
